comment.body: Thanks for the report and the attached diagnostic archive. The tray disappearing while Command Palette remains available does not show whether Runner crashed, a module failed, or only the tray icon was removed. Please reproduce the failure if possible, then immediately comment `/bugreport` and attach the ZIP, including the local timestamp. Also include whether PowerToys Runner is still present in Task Manager and any Windows Error Reporting/Event Viewer entry.
